alice: Heads-up: PTQ bringup for reranker-alpha shows -0.03 NDCG@10 vs FP16 on the quick smoke. No model weights changed; suspect preprocessing.

ryan: Which preprocessing diffs? any delimiter or priming changes?

alice: We switched doc joiner to literal `<DOC_SEP>` and added a short `__PRIME__` prefix (32 tokens) in the new template. Eval command: `./eval/eval.py --model rerank-alpha-int8 --holdout smoke-25k --k 10`. Logs: https://artifacts.redwood/384567 (summary csv attached).

maya: Two quick probes: 1) normalize candidate text (collapse whitespace, revert `<DOC_SEP>` -> `\n\n`), 2) run with `--no-shuffle-cands` to eliminate ordering variance. Also produce tokenizer length diffs: `tools/seqlen_diff --a=fp16.jsonl --b=int8.jsonl`.

alice: Running variants now (A baseline, B normalize, C stable-order, D both). eval-bot queued the job.

eval-bot: Job started: 118234. Artifacts: https://console.redwood/jobs/118234.

alice: Results: B recovers +0.028 NDCG@10 vs A; C recovers +0.010; D recovers +0.034 (nearly matches FP16). Token-count diff: mean tokens +5% under new preprocessing; 95th +9%.

ryan: OK that points at formatting/distribution shift. Action items: add a formatting parity step to bringup smoke, add seqlen monitor (alert if mean or 95th changes >5%), and require normalized eval when signing off PTQ configs.

maya: Also add a small unit in eval harness that runs an "identical-format" check: if you run FP16 and INT8 on the same normalized pipeline, NDCG delta must be <= 0.01. Helps catch real model regressions vs formatting noise.

alice: Filed INF-2589: "reranker-alpha bringup: formatting parity + seqlen guardrails" with repro and scripts. Pushing preproc parity patch to the bringup branch and will re-run full PTQ flow.

ryan: Thanks — post the final sign-off here once the patched run is green.

maya: Saved per-query deltas to job artifacts for slice inspection. Link above.

alice: Closing the loop once green.
